Name: Mixed Seed Improvement
Author: EspressoNex
Description:
I have used several mods related to mixed seeds but have never been satisfied with them.

For example, "[i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40887]Mixed Seeds Expanded[/url][/i]" can mix and filter well, but in the greenhouse and on Ginger Island you can only plant crops of the current season; "[i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44365]Mix All The Seeds[/url][/i]" allows you to plant crops from all seasons, but it causes the filtering of regrowing crops and trellis crops to fail. I really like these mods, but obviously they all have some issues.

Therefore, with AI assistance, I referenced [url=https://github.com/Mushymato/MixAllTheSeeds]them[/url] and made this mod for my own use, and I’m sharing it with everyone. Thanks for the support. If there is any infringement or offense, please contact me.
